{"command": "python3 - <<'EOF'
import json,hashlib,pathlib
reg=json.load(open('checksum_register.json'))
for p,d in reg['digests'].items():
    actual=hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    print(len(d), len(actual), 'MATCH' if d==actual else 'MISMATCH', p)
EOF", "description": "Compare registered digest lengths and values"}
